title: Unguided Media: Radio Waves, Microwaves, Infrared
topics: Unguided Media: Radio Waves, Microwaves, Infrared
keyPoints: Unguided media transport electromagnetic waves without a physical conductor (slide 26).
Radio waves: multicast (radio, TV, paging), penetrate walls, omnidirectional antennas (slide 31).
Microwaves: unicast (cellular, satellite, WLAN), line-of-sight, directional antennas (slide 33).
Infrared: short range in a closed area, line of sight (slide 35).
